findings.rotation: OpenStax vertebral-joints discussion: lumbar facets largely prohibit rotation; the thoracic cage limits flexion and other motions. It does not specify the exact endpoints used here.
findings.external_oblique: Costal digitations arise on ribs 5–12. Elongated lateral fleshy belly transitions anteriorly into a broad aponeurosis; anterior fibers are predominantly inferior-medial, posterior fibers descend toward the iliac crest more vertically.
findings.internal_oblique: Intermediate layer; fibers predominantly superior and medial; displayed through a cutaway.
findings.serratus_anterior: Costal slips on ribs 1–8 or 1–9 converge toward the costal surface of the medial scapular border. Upper slips are partly covered by pectoral context.
findings.rectus_abdominis: Paired muscle from pubic crest/symphysis toward xiphoid and upper costal cartilages; linea alba and three tendinous intersections.
findings.latissimus_dorsi: Broad posterior lower-thoracic/thoracolumbar-fascial/iliac sheet converges toward the posterior axillary fold; actual humerus is omitted. The superficial sheet wraps around the cage. Opaque visibility now compares camera depth against posed bones, pectoral context and other muscle surfaces, rather than backface orientation alone.
findings.pectoral_context: Compact curved anterior chest fan with fibers converging to the anterior axillary fold/proximal humeral context. Sternum and pectoral context share a frame; near/far fans are sorted after deformation.

illustrative_choices.limits: No subject-specific measurements, muscle sliding, activation, pressure or clinical joint/contact simulation. SVG layers depict anatomical overlap; this is not a volumetric dissection renderer.
illustrative_choices.upper_thorax_plateau: T1–T4 shoulder/rib-cage block; remaining thoracic rotation distributed below; an illustrative coupling constraint, not clinical regional motion data
illustrative_choices.yaw_axis: Fixed pelvic longitudinal axis; vertebral centerline curvature rotates with the torso

visual_guide.description: User-approved colored concept in this chat guided the silhouette and separation of external-oblique belly/aponeurosis. The user supplied a separate dissection reference for that relationship. The generated concept is not used as anatomical ground truth.

recheck.reason: Previous coordinate/opacity checks did not verify attachment topology or anatomical silhouettes. This recheck compares textbook figure 1112, 1118 and 1119 directly with the rendered front/lateral/yaw plates.
observed_errors: EO drawn as a narrow lateral strip with unrelated costal teeth
SA front insertion assigned anterior depth instead of costal scapular surface
Latissimus modeled as a long strap ending at shoulder-joint height rather than proximal humeral context
Pectoral sternocostal origin cut off above lower costal cartilages
Generic height deformation let muscle origins move differently from corresponding rigid ribs
Torso width changed discontinuously at y=345 and y=410, producing fiber kinks
corrections: UV attachment patches wrap around a smooth torso width/depth profile
SA origins ribs 1–8 follow each rib; insertions follow costal medial scapular border
EO origins ribs 5–12 include posterior lower costal branches; anterior belly joins broad aponeurosis and posterior fibers approach iliac crest
Latissimus broad lower-thoracic/fascial/iliac origins converge to omitted proximal humeral context; iliac origin stays fixed
Pectoral fan includes inferior sternocostal extent and ends below shoulder joint
Back-facing mesh cells and fiber segments are excluded from opaque rendering; transparent groups reveal the complete sheet
recheck.verification_scope: Attachment probes compare to actual rendered rib polylines, not just to the deformation function. Tests establish drawing consistency, not an anatomically validated volumetric model or clinical range of motion.

contact_and_occlusion_recheck.prior_failure: Independent SA/EO patches and camera-facing clipping did not establish interdigitation, whole-surface clearance or foreground rib occlusion. Endpoint checks passed while these visible relationships remained wrong.
changes: One interdigitating contact boundary for SA ribs 5–8 and EO ribs 5–8, shared through every pose.
Lateral contact descends obliquely; posterior EO origins on ribs 9–12 and latissimus lateral border complete the flank.
Radial wrapping replaces straight chords through the cage; posed cage/body cross-sections constrain interior surface points.
Per-sample camera depth supplies opaque SVG clips; transparency reveals complete muscle groups.
Lateral scapular depth places its costal SA insertion underneath the bone.
contact_and_occlusion_recheck.validation: 23 poses; continuous shared boundary; interior shell clearance; independent foreground-bone occlusion fixture with reversed drawing order; original attachment/bone/cartilage checks; opacity/state/mobile/touch. Numerical checks constrain this drawing and do not certify medical anatomy.
contact_and_occlusion_recheck.limitations: Coronal and lateral skeletal drawings remain separate landmark adapters. Muscle attachment bands, soft tissue sliding and actual humeral insertions are approximations. No measured volumetric anatomical model.

fascicle_and_yaw_recheck.visual_reference: User-supplied lateral dissection and OpenStax 11.12; generated concepts are not anatomical evidence.
fascicle_and_yaw_recheck.shape: Rounded upper SA costal slips, posterior inter-rib recesses in the shared lower SA/upper EO boundary, broader lateral EO belly with anterior-inferior upper fibers.
fascicle_and_yaw_recheck.movement: Actual attachment displacement corrections and angular interpolation; eased thoracic yaw; anterior fascia/rectus coupled to costal/xiphoid boundary above and fixed pelvic attachments below; body-derived envelope center and conservative outer smoothing.
fascicle_and_yaw_recheck.validation: 23 poses; original fiber stability upper bound 1.8 retained, measured maximum 1.755; actual rendered EO/sheath contact, upper anterior wall follows sternum, lower wall fixed; opacity/state/mobile/touch passed.
fascicle_and_yaw_recheck.limits: Drawing geometry and illustrative motion distribution, not measured clinical ranges, volumetric anatomy or physiological strain.

inferior_serratus_fan_recheck.problem: Inferior costal and scapular insertion heights had similar ranges, leaving nearly parallel horizontal stripes despite the previous strain checks.
inferior_serratus_fan_recheck.anatomical_basis: User dissection reference and existing OpenStax references: costal slips wrap to costal medial scapular border, inferior fibers converge around inferior angle.
changes: Anterolateral inferior costal origins with increasing heights; original posterior eighth-rib origin removed.
Narrower inferior-angle insertion range, retaining upper/middle medial-border insertions.
Shared muscle/fiber surface with superiorly curved inferior fascicles visible before posterior concealment.
Duplicate clamped edge fiber strokes removed without changing the palette or UI.
inferior_serratus_fan_recheck.verification: 23 poses, existing attachment/contact/clearance/strain/opacity/mobile checks; additional convergence and displayed near-flank direction criteria at both yaw endpoints; no coincident rendered SA fibers.
inferior_serratus_fan_recheck.limits: Illustrative projected fan and separate coronal/lateral landmark adapters; no clinical fiber angle, measured muscle volume or physiological strain claim.

primary_evidence: OpenStax m46495 table: ribs 1–8/1–9 to anterior surface of vertebral scapular border.
OpenStax 11.18 actual anatomy plate: wrapping thoracic slips and scapular direction.
OpenStax 11.12 and m46485: SA/EO interdigitation; EO inferomedial fibers and anterior aponeurosis.
rejected_choices: Additional superior sine bow of 5–10 drawing units to force the displayed fan.
An arbitrarily required insertion/origin span ratio below 0.3 and projected direction spread above 25 degrees.
Generic upper thoracic envelope wider than the authored costal skeleton.
changes: Remove the additional vertical SA bow.
Spread inferior insertions along a finite region of the existing lower medial scapular border.
Reduce depth of the shared costal interdigitations.
Generate upper thoracic width stations from actual authored rib extents/heights.
attachment_based_serratus_correction.limits: Attachment coordinates, insertion spread and tooth depth remain illustrative adapters. Anatomy plates support topology and direction, not measured coordinates, patient-specific deformation or clinical 60-degree ROM. Local curvature does not uniformly decrease across all fibers.
